status_legend.in_progress: The feature is the current active task (only one at a time).
status_legend.blocked: Work cannot continue until a documented blocker is resolved.
status_legend.passing: Required verification has passed and evidence is recorded by hx verify.

features.title: Frontend scaffold: npm workspace (web), React 19 + Vite 8 + TypeScript + Mantine 9 + TanStack Query + React Router, ESLint, Vitest + Testing Library, README, docs/FRONTEND.md
features.user_visible_behavior: On a clean clone: npm ci && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test:unit all exit 0; npm run dev serves the app on :5173 and proxies /api to the backend on :3001.

features.title: Design system + data foundation: Mantine theme tokens, shared UI components (PageHeader, StatusBadge, DataTable, EmptyState, LoadingState, ErrorState, ConfirmDialog, StatCard, MaskedValue), formatters (GBP, en-GB dates), typed API client (CSRF header, ApiError), QueryClient defaults
features.user_visible_behavior: Every page uses one theme and one set of components; every non-GET request carries x-requested-with: omnia-recon; server errors surface as { code, message, details }.

features.title: Auth + app shell: login page, session via /api/auth/me, protected routes, role-aware navigation, logout, change password, 401 session-expiry handling, not-found/forbidden pages
features.user_visible_behavior: Signed-out users land on /login; wrong password, locked account and rate limit each show a distinct message; after sign-in the app shell shows the user and role; logout returns to /login; an expired session redirects to /login and returns to the same page after sign-in.

verification.cmd: npm run test:unit -- src/features/auth src/app src/data/auth

features.title: User administration (admin only): list users, create, change role, deactivate/reactivate, reset password, via /api/users
features.user_visible_behavior: An admin sees the Users page, creates a user (password >= 12 chars), changes a role and deactivates a user; non-admins never see the page or its nav item and get the forbidden page if they open the URL.

features.title: Bank CSV upload + import history + import detail with match summary (matched / needs review / yet to take / excluded); typed mock data until backend recon-201/202 ship
features.user_visible_behavior: Staff pick a bank account and a CSV, upload it and see rows inserted / duplicates skipped and the match summary; a re-upload shows the duplicate-file rejection; import history lists every batch with status. Screens backed by mock data show a visible 'Preview data' marker.

features.title: Bank transactions list (shape of v_bank_statement_enriched): filter by bank / date / status, search, masked NI and payer account, resolved_via shown; typed mock data until backend ships
features.user_visible_behavior: Staff filter lines by bank, date range and status, see TID, tenant, masked NI, ledger status and how each line was resolved; numbers right-aligned in GBP; table stays usable at 1000+ rows.

features.title: Review queue: suggestions with confidence + reason, accept / pick another tenancy / remember payer / reject, yet-to-take list with manual match (mirrors backend recon-203); typed mock data until recon-202 API ships
features.user_visible_behavior: A reviewer opens a needs_review line, sees each suggestion's confidence and reason, accepts one (optionally 'remember this payer') or searches for another tenancy; readonly users see the queue but no action buttons.

features.title: Receipts + allocations: receipt list and detail with allocations to rent periods, reverse a receipt (mirrors backend recon-204); typed mock data until backend ships
features.user_visible_behavior: Staff open a receipt and see its allocations per rent period as returned by the server; reversing requires a reason and confirmation; readonly users cannot reverse.

features.title: Tenants + tenancies lookup: search by TID / name / NI, tenancy detail with RG/MG/IRG, payer balances (mirrors backend recon-102/103); NI masked except for admin/accounts; typed mock data until backend ships
features.user_visible_behavior: Staff search by TID, name or full NI and open a tenancy showing status, management type and balances per payer as returned by the server; NI shows only the last 3 characters unless the server returns it for admin/accounts.

features.title: Exports: filled-in bank statement CSV download (filters bank/date/status) and Vico export file with exported-once history (mirrors backend recon-301/302); typed mock data until backend ships
features.user_visible_behavior: Staff choose filters and download the bank statement CSV; the Vico page lists receipts not yet exported and produces the file once; exported batches are listed.

features.title: Xero sync status: connection state, invoice outbox (pending / draft / approved / voided / error) per receipt, retry failed (mirrors backend recon-303); typed mock data until backend ships
features.user_visible_behavior: Accounts staff see whether Xero is connected and each receipt's invoice status with ledger code; failed syncs show the error and can be retried by writers.

features.title: Dashboard: today's imports per bank, auto-match rate, review backlog, balances per payer, arrears ageing (mirrors backend recon-401); figures come from the server, typed mock data until backend ships
features.user_visible_behavior: After sign-in staff see today's imports per bank, the auto-match rate, how many lines await review or are yet to take, and arrears ageing buckets, each linking to the filtered list.
